what: Ticket 1180's plan and the lead's brief said the local host guard refuses next/apps/fabrika/src/instance-one-file.integration.test.ts in the cloud box. It does not: vitest.hostrun.ts allows a Linux box with CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true on purpose. So the tests agent ran the real-instance law here, it timed out on a missing build and left workerd children, and the agent ended them by hand, which the lead's rule for this lane (no process signals in the box) meant to avoid.
cause: The plan and the brief stated the guard's answer from memory of the laptop case, not from vitest.hostrun.ts's table.
fix: A brief that keeps a law off the box says so as its own rule, with the file named, since the guard allows every real-resource law in a cloud box.
test: The next lane's brief names each law the box must not start, and its tests row shows none started.
